Chuck Norris: A Tribute to the Only Man Who Can Kick the Sun into the Sunset 🦅👊

short // Apr 15, 2026 · Updated Sep 24, 2026

Watch on YouTube

Whether he was fighting in Rome or protecting the Texas border, Chuck Norris was the ultimate symbol of justice. He's also the only man who can kick the sun into the sunset. Those are just facts.

Chuck Norris died on March 19, 2026, at 86. So this one is a tribute to a legend: a real martial artist, a real action star, and the only man who became an internet meme without even trying.

The fighter before the movies

Before Hollywood, Norris was the real deal. He started training in martial arts while serving in the U.S. Air Force in South Korea, became a world karate champion and went on to create his own style, Chun Kuk Do. When he threw a kick on screen, you knew he could throw it for real.

Fighting Bruce Lee in the Colosseum

In 1972's The Way of the Dragon, Norris faced Bruce Lee in Rome's Colosseum. It's one of the most famous fight scenes ever filmed: two real martial artists, no tricks, in a building made for gladiators. Norris lost the fight, but he walked out of that movie a star.

The '80s action run

In the '80s, Norris was a one-man action franchise. Missing in Action. Code of Silence. Invasion U.S.A. The Delta Force. If you grew up with a VCR, there's a good chance a Chuck Norris tape was sitting on the shelf.

Walker, Texas Ranger

Then came Cordell Walker. Walker, Texas Ranger ran on CBS from 1993 to 2001 and made Norris a Saturday-night staple for a whole generation. Bad guys, roundhouse kicks and a lesson at the end. That's the Chuck Norris a lot of us grew up with.

The Expendables 2 and the cobra

By 2012, the internet had already turned him into a legend with "Chuck Norris facts." So in The Expendables 2, he got to play right into it. His character, Booker, is asked about a rumor that he was bitten by a king cobra. His answer: yes, and after five days of agonizing pain, the cobra died.

Nothing sums up Chuck Norris better, except maybe a roundhouse kick.

Why he mattered

Chuck Norris went from real champion to movie star to TV icon to meme, and he stayed Chuck Norris the whole way through: tough, calm and on the side of the good guys.

Rest easy, Walker.

Quick answers

When did Chuck Norris die? On March 19, 2026, at age 86, after a medical emergency in Hawaii.

Did Chuck Norris fight Bruce Lee? Yes, on screen. Their fight in Rome's Colosseum is the climax of The Way of the Dragon (1972).

How long did Walker, Texas Ranger run? Eight seasons, from 1993 to 2001, on CBS.

What's the Chuck Norris cobra joke? In The Expendables 2, his character says he was bitten by a king cobra and, after five days of agonizing pain, the cobra died.
